multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: Once per battle it holds on with 1 HP after a knockout blow.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.description: Foes that hit it in melee take 8 damage.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.description: Shakes off foes' statuses at the start of its turn, after status damage.

natural-recovery.name: Natural Recovery
natural-recovery.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

ingrain-grip.name: Rooted Grip
ingrain-grip.description: Heals 4% of max HP each turn while engaged.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.description: Heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.description: Steps away from engaged foes without free attacks.

mean-look.name: Mean Look
mean-look.description: Foes engaged with it cannot slip away without its free attack.

pursuit-instinct.name: Pursuit Instinct
pursuit-instinct.description: Its free attacks on fleeing foes deal 25% more damage.

pin-down.name: Pin Down
pin-down.description: Foes engaged with it take 15% more damage from its allies.

flanker.name: Flanker
flanker.description: +15% damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

long-reach.name: Long Reach
long-reach.description: +15% damage to foes out of melee reach.

overhead-shot.name: Overhead Shot
overhead-shot.description: Its ranged moves fire over other Pokémon.

first-strike.name: First Strike
first-strike.description: +20% damage to foes at full HP.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: +15% damage to foes carrying any status.

exploit-opening.name: Exploit Opening
exploit-opening.description: +20% damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: +30% damage while it carries a status, and Burn doesn't lower its damage.

quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.description: +2 movement while it carries a status, and Paralysis doesn't stop it moving.

cornered.name: Cornered
cornered.description: +20% damage while two or more foes stand next to it.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.description: All its moves deal 10% more damage.

relentless.name: Relentless
relentless.description: +10% damage per hit in a row on the same foe (up to 3).

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.description: Knocking out a foe raises its Attack for the battle (up to +3).

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn gives 2 more movement.

follow-through.name: Follow Through
follow-through.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

battle-high.name: Battle High
battle-high.description: Knocking out a foe resets its move cooldowns.

battle-bond.name: Battle Bond
battle-bond.description: +1 team Bond when it knocks out a foe.

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.description: +1 team Bond when it lands a combo.

bond-focus.name: Bond Focus
bond-focus.description: Its Bond moves cost 1 less (at least 1).

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: While deployed, the team starts battles with +1 Bond.

lingering-effects.name: Lingering Effects
lingering-effects.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer (not Paralysis, Freeze or Sleep; at most +2 in all).

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.description: Its non-damaging moves recharge 1 turn faster (to at least 1).

lingering-aroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingering-aroma.description: Statuses it put on a fainted foe spread to that foe's neighbours for 1 turn (harmful ones only).

static.name: Static
static.description: Foes that hit it in melee are Paralyzed for 1 turn.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.description: Foes that hit it in melee are Burned for 1 turn.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.description: Foes that hit it in melee are Slowed for 1 turn.

sand-force.name: Sand Force
sand-force.description: +20% damage to foes standing on mud.

bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
bulldozer.description: Pushing a foe into an obstacle deals 10 more damage.

big-root.name: Big Root
big-root.description: Its draining moves heal 20% more of the damage.

pincer.name: Pincer
pincer.description: +20% to its Fighting flank bonus when an ally also stands next to the target.

swarm-tactics.name: Swarm Tactics
swarm-tactics.description: +15% to its swarm bonus per ally next to the target.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: Fire moves deal 30% more damage while below half HP.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: Grass moves deal 30% more damage while below half HP.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Water moves deal 30% more damage while below half HP.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Bug moves deal 30% more damage while below half HP.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.description: Its free attacks on foes stepping away from it deal 50% more damage.

poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 2 turns.

far-sight.name: Far Sight
far-sight.description: +1 range on moves that already reach 2 or more (up to 3; Bond moves no limit).
